question: Do mixed DuPage RNA interactions align with activation-repressed source classes and independently measured activation-associated H3K27me3 context?
decision: Determine whether a limited cross-study regulatory association is supported or whether selective repression remains unqualified; permit S4 only for a specific unresolved discriminator.
strongest_rival: Mathematical coupling of HET-defined classes, bulk population selection, expression detectability and broad multi-gene chromatin domains can mimic a selective repression association.
discriminator: Separate internal HET-down/up directions from externally sourced chromatin signal. Use pinned within-mm9 gene-domain overlap and exact same-chromosome symbols, uncovered-gene accounting, expression strata and single-gene-domain sensitivity. Does not identify direct targets or measured KO chromatin mediation.
exposure_record: Published results, S0-S2 and Arvey main text/metadata/README and table headers are exposed. No gene-domain overlaps or cross-study correlations have been computed before freeze. This is adapted exploratory description, not confirmation or exact Figure 6 replay.
biological_unit: DuPage source preparations with unknown mouse/pool nesting; Arvey activated/resting Treg ChIP samples described as two replicates per state, individual mouse/pool identities not audited. Gene/domain summaries are not biological replicates.
nesting_and_overlap: DuPage S1/S2 reuse one study. Arvey is a different source/activation context but is already the external chromatin source used in DuPage 2015; this is one published analytical lineage, not independent replication of the original claim. Multi-gene domains induce shared signal.
population_and_selection: DuPage healthy mosaic female spleen/LN Foxp3-positive CD62L strata; Arvey spleen/LN resting Tregs versus in-vivo activated Tregs after transient DT depletion/inflammation. Different activation contexts and no matched DuPage KO chromatin.
contrast: DuPage S2 interaction versus Arvey mean atr.rep1/2 minus mean rtr.rep1/2 on deposited log2(RPKM+0.3), quantile-normalized scale. Internal HET activation-down/up groups retained separately.
endpoint: Descriptive signed gene-level RNA/chromatin association and mapping/detectability coverage; no enrichment p-values or causal endpoints.
methods: Use fixed S1 11614 loci and S2 interactions. Parse GEO qn table with unique named columns; no additional log transform. Map domains to all mm9 RefGene transcript bodies using txStart/txEnd; retain gene/domain pairs stable to start versus start-1 boundary convention, collapse duplicate transcripts, exclude multi-chromosome symbols. Join exact same-chromosome symbols to RNA; median domain difference per gene. Keep uncovered distinct from nonpositive. Report all-domain and single-gene-domain Spearman correlations without p-values, internal activation classes and positive/nonpositive external change groups. Five equal-count HET/high-expression rank bins provide descriptive detectability strata. No cross-build coordinate join or alias guessing.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new RNA filtering beyond S1. Exclude nonfinite source signal, duplicated domain IDs, unsupported columns or ambiguous gene chromosome identity; fail malformed sources. Preserve uncovered genes and boundary-sensitive mapping counts. Missing exact Foxp3-loss/binding/signature sets remain held.
multiplicity: No inferential tests. Fixed two descriptive association views, three RNA contrasts and internal/external signed classes with five expression bins; all outputs retained.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Cross-study association with broad marked domains under different activation contexts is not direct binding, locus-specific KO chromatin loss, identity fate, function or mediation. Internal class directions share HET terms with the interaction and cannot independently support repression. Quantile normalization cannot estimate global methylation abundance.
stop_rule: Fail malformed/nonfinite signal, empty mapped universe or inconsistent RNA gene order. If exact reference replay cannot be qualified, retain its hold; use only the explicitly adapted AM01 branch. Mixed/negative association must not trigger unbounded external screening.
amendment_reason: Initial S3 numerical contract implementing prospective plan amendment Dp1-AM01 (ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT_V2.md); no predecessor S3 run exists. Recovered explicit GEO signal semantics replace an unqualified exact published-set replay.
